newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products unchanged to weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products unchanged to weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to narrowly weaker on Monday, traders said.
Gas oil premiums came under some early pressure, but recovered slightly towards the close as late futures gains drew fresh buying interest although trade was thin.

Gasoline was slightly lower but tighter supply was expected to underpin Eurograde barges. Naphtha fell slightly. A Spanish end user was rumoured to have sold a Skikda cargo to be stemmed with another cargo and head for the States.
Fuel was weaker amid sagging demand and well supplied Russian material. -- London newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
